messages:
Maria P (partnerships): FYI partner emailed asking for "signed usage proofs" for every daily batch + clear prorate handling for plan switches. They want a runbook by EOW.
Alex B (billing): Do they mean cryptographic receipts or just signed CSVs? :thinking_face: 
Maria P (partnerships): They used the phrase "exchangeable proofs" and called out non-repudiation. I asked for an example payload but haven't got one yet.
Derek E (eng): We can support HMAC-signed payloads easily. If they insist on asymmetric signatures (RSA/ED25519) we'll need key onboarding + verification in ingest path.
Jonah I (infra): HMAC ok for most, but partner wants per-usage-item id to trace dedupe and backfills. We should require idempotency keys and a signed timestamp.
Claire O (ops): Also need SLA for late arrivals/backfills — how many days are we accepting re-signed batches before we reject them? That's a billing risk.
Alex B (billing): Proposal: accept backfills up to 7 days for crediting; >7 days require manual review. Prorates: split-day charges should be proportional to seconds on each plan. Any objections?
Maria P (partnerships): sounds reasonable. Partner may push for 30 days though. We should document our reconciliation flow first.
Derek E (eng): Minimal required fields in the signed message:
```
{
  "usage_id": "uuid",
  "customer_id": "acct-123",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-15T23:00:00Z",
  "units": 1234,
  "metric": "tokens",
  "plan_snapshot": {"sku":"pro","seats":10},
  "idempotency_key": "sha256(...)",
  "signature": "BASE64_SIG"
}
```
We verify signature, then check idempotency_key+usage_id dedupe.
Alex B (billing): Good. For prorate calc we need plan change timestamp and prior plan snapshot. If partner provides plan_snapshot per item we can avoid a separate plan-sync step.
Jonah I (infra): Ingest pipeline impact: signature verification adds CPU. We should allow partner to mark batches as "low-priority" for asynchronous verification to avoid tail latency spikes.
Claire O (ops): Need alerting on signed-batch verification failure rate >1% and on excessive backfill volume. Add an ops runbook for manual review owners.
marketplace-bot: schema-deploy succeeded for partner-signatures v1 — route /ingest/partner-signed now live in staging.
Derek E (eng): QA checklist:
- verify signature acceptance for RSA/ED25519/HMAC
- idempotency tests (replay older items)
- backfill window enforcement
- prorate unit tests across DST/timezones
Maria P (partnerships): I'll push partner to provide a sample signed batch today. Action items:
- Alex: draft prorate rules + exceptions (due Fri)
- Derek: add signature verification + idempotency design doc (due Wed)
- Jonah: perf cost estimate for verification and async queue (due Wed)
- Claire: ops runbook draft (due Thu)
Alex B (billing): noted. I'll also include a failure mitigation: if signature verification fails at scale, we fallback to manual ingest with escrow flag.
Jonah I (infra): one more Q — do we want partner-signed IDs to be canonical source of truth for usage_id? or still reconcile against our own ingestion ids?
Derek E (eng): We'll keep our ingestion_id but accept partner usage_id as external_id. Reconciliation maps external_id -> ingestion_id and marks source=partner.
Maria P (partnerships): Perfect. I'll update partner and ask for sample by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
